mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sending_count, ROUND(AVG(cost_millis), 2) AS avg_cost_millis FROM email_send_record WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY stat_date DESC

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 10 ) SELECT recipient, COUNT(*) AS send_count FROM ( SELECT TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.to_addresses, ',', seq.n), ',', -1)) AS recipient FROM email_send_record r JOIN seq ON seq.n <= 1 + CHAR_LENGTH(r.to_addresses) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(r.to_addresses, ',', '')) ) t WHERE recipient <> '' GROUP BY recipient ORDER BY send_count DESC, recipient ASC LIMIT #{limit}
